1981-2415-4716-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4716-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

2023-4289-4770-7175.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1818-2173-4247-5010.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-2173-4247-5010.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

38-978-2420.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Skirk Prospector ability.
Repeat.

1619-2438-4605-5542-6146.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6146.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Ravenloft Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Ravenloft Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ravenloft Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Ravenloft Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Ravenloft Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Ravenloft Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6146.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1020-2866-4050-7692.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Shuri.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {1}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Shuri.
Repeat.

2034-5696-6318.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U} if you don't have eight energy counters plus enough mana to pay for Jyoti's commander tax
2034-5696-6318.notablePrerequisites: You've cast Jyoti from the command zone at least three times this game.
2034-5696-6318.description:
Cast Jyoti from the command zone by paying eight {E} (if able) due to Nissa, or by paying {2}{G}{U} otherwise, plus its commander tax.
When Jyoti enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad creature token for each time you've cast Jyoti from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter, Nissa triggers that many times, causing you to get {E}{E} for each Forest Dryad.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jyoti, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Jyoti to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing all but one Forest Dryad that was created in step 2, adding {C}{C} for each Forest Dryad sacrificed.
Repeat
2034-5696-6318.notes: If you have eight or more {E} to start, you don't need the {2}{G}{U} to cast Jyoti. You will need the mana to cover Jyoti's commander tax regardless of whether you pay Jyoti's mana cost or opt to spend eight {E} instead.

1765-1879-2440-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1765-1879-2440-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

1558-3129-3875-4231-5233.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3129-3875-4231-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

443-5256-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
443-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Magus of the Bridge and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

930-4779-6871-6879.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat from step 3.

539-2034-7085.description:
Cast Earth Kingdom General by paying its mana cost
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Earth Kingdom General
When Earth Kingdom General dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earth Kingdom General enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.

1849-2105-6911.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Combat Celebrant has vigilance.
1849-2105-6911.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks and triggering its ability, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Combat Celebrant, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that isn't legendary.
During your next combat phase, declare Combat Celebrant and the Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant token triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

225-5702-6871.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You control a land that enters untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G}.
225-5702-6871.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, animating a land you control that enters the battlefield untapped.
During your next turn, cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to an animated land.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a copy of the land it is attached to.
When the land token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a copy of the land it is attached to.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2523-5297.description:
Activate Sarkhan's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing it to become a legendary 4/4 Dragon creature with flying, indestructible and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sarkhan.
When Sarkhan dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Sarkhan that isn't legendary.
Repeat using the Sarkhan token.

3197-4017-6458.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
3197-4017-6458.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3197-4017-4506.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-4017-4506.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

671-1274-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-1274-5641.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

147-2292-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1251-2457-4289-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2511-4616-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2511-4616-6249--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2781-4050-5987.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Angel of Indemnity.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

5173-5553-5626-5930.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4050-5544-5749.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Athreos triggers, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1694-2584-3059.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Malignus enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing an amount of damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the legendary creature.

804-3039-3258-4450.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima the Impostor is a copy of Carth the Lion.
804-3039-3258-4450.description:
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Activate Liliana Vess's second loyalty ability by removing zero loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows, then shuffling your library and putting it on top.
Move to your next turn, drawing Beacon of Tomorrows during your draw step.
Repeat.

4067-4359-4499.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard that were put there this turn.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
4067-4359-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Garna.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning all creature cards that were put into your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
If you have four or more creature cards in your graveyard that were put there this turn, or if the mana-producing permanent can tap to produce at least {2}, this combo nets infinite mana and infinite blinking.

386-2152-5280.notablePrerequisites: Glistening Oil attached to Fate Unraveler.
386-2152-5280.description:
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library and draw seven cards.
Fate Unraveler triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library, draw seven cards, and exile Echo of Eons.
Fate Unraveler triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

31-1068-1940-2034.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, exiling your library.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any creature, adding {C}{C}.
Liliana triggers, causing you to return any creature from your graveyard to the battlefield due to Out of the Tombs.
Repeat from step 3.

415-2607-3059.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Xathrid Demon triggers, causing you to sacrifice Malignus and causing each opponent to lose life equal to Malignus's power.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

387-1531-2530-4050-4529.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
387-1531-2530-4050-4529.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least four.
You control less than two Thrulls.
387-1531-2530-4050-4529.description:
Cast God-Eternal Bontu either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{B} and commander tax, if applicable.
Endrek Sahr triggers, creating five 1/1 Thrull creature tokens.
The Thrull tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Carnival of Souls five times.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two Thrull tokens, adding {B}{B}.
Deathgreeter triggers twice, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve each Carnival of Souls, causing you to lose five life and add {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve God-Eternal Bontu from step 1.
God-Eternal Bontu enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing God-Eternal Bontu, adding {B}.
God-Eternal Bontu's second ability and Deathgreeter trigger.
Resolve the God-Eternal Bontu trigger, causing you to put it into your library third from the top from your graveyard.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve God-Eternal Bontu's first ability from step 8, sacrificing three Thrulls and drawing three cards.
Deathgreeter triggers three times, causing you to gain three life.
Repeat.
Once you have an empty library, you can continue the combo by only sacrificing one Thrull in step 13, and sacrificing the other two Thrulls to Phyrexian Altar.
